## Step 5: Review and approve one recommendation

1. Run the automation against the seeded issues and compare one recommendation with the issue and rubric.
2. On that seeded issue, post one marked approval comment and apply exactly one priority label: `P1`, `P2`, or `P3`.

```text
<!-- step-5-approval:start -->
Decision: <approved or corrected priority and topic label>
Evidence: <specific synthetic issue evidence>
Rubric rule: <matching condition>
Human reviewer: approved
<!-- step-5-approval:end -->
```

Edit the existing comment and labels when retrying; do not post duplicate approval blocks.
